description: This file contains authentication service functions for a React frontend, utilizing Supabase for auth operations such as session retrieval, sign-in, sign-up, and sign-out.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current Supabase authentication session, returning null if not authenticated.

methods.name: onAuthStateChange
methods.description: Subscribes to auth state changes and executes a callback with the current session; returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: signInWithEmail
methods.description: Sends a magic link email to sign in the user, redirecting to a specified URL.

methods.name: signUpWithEmail
methods.description: Initiates a passwordless sign-up flow using email magic link.
